label: HeaderEquivalence-Wrappers-v4
old_header:
(D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    ∃ a ≤ 2 * T + 5, ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) tapes heads b
new_header:
(D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    ∃ a ≤ 2 * T + 5, ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (show Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x from by
          simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x)) tapes heads b
identity: equality of complete forall theorem types by kernel-checked rfl
